name: The Wild
description: The Wild is a South African soap opera created by Rohan Dickson, Richard Nosworthy and Bronwyn Berry and produced by M-Net's in-house production arm Magic Factory and shot entirely on location which revolves around three families – the Lebones, the van Reenens and the Tladis - who, because of past conflicts, struggle to negotiate a cohesive future, despite being bound together by their relationship to a special piece of land.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Dinaledi Lodge prepares for a banquet to celebrate the concession agreement but everyone's world is thrown into crisis when Tiro threatens to sell the land. Tristan convinces Tiro that illegal hunting is going on and that it is an inside job. Bernie has to leave her comfort zone to save the Morula Berry Cake from being a failure for another year.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Tiro's decision to sell the land comes under pressure from both Itumeleng and his own family, and causes ructions amongst the van Reenen's.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Bernie ventures into the bush with Karel and makes a meaningful connection. Khumo's dodgy life-style impacts on his family and Diksie takes a stand.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The initial spark between Tiro and Lelo grows into an increasing fascination with each other - a fascination which raises eyebrows amongst the guests at the banquet and causes Itumeleng to over-react and get into a fight with Tiro.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The pressure is building on Tristan from both Karel and Kate to ease off on his investigation of the illegal hunting.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Tristan ploughs on with his investigation, and chooses to confront Itumeleng with the evidence of the dead rhino. Lelo attempts to convince herself that Modise is really the man for her.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Tiro arrives at the Chic Young Designer Awards and Zoe has to run interference.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Isaac takes on orientation and impresses everyone except Jack.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: A hunting party arrives and Jack is tempted to offer them an illegal kill, Modise wants an answer from Lelo.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Kate is drawn into the hunt by Jack, much to Tristan's annoyance, and Jack shifts his focus, to Kate.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Jack begins to fear that Bernie could be in real danger from Itumeleng. Jack begins to insinuate his way between Tristan and Kate, which infuriates Tristan.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Jack cannot help himself: he offers the hunters an illegal Kudu bull.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Lelo barely has time to catch her breath after getting engaged when Itumeleng sets about planning the wedding.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Modise and Lelo stand up for themselves but can't help offending those who want to play a part in their wedding.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Tristan reveals to Kate the promise of a new dream that she doesn't completely share.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: With pressure mounting on the engaged couple, Lelo admits that she hasn't been open with her family about Modise and then lies to herself about Tiro.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: After being teased and questioned by his siblings, Tiro decides an attack strategy is the best way to move on from Lelo.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: The lack of privacy at the lodge corners Itumeleng into telling Bernie they can't be together, but Bernie has other ideas.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Head ranger Jack stays one step ahead of nemesis Tristan, while Lelo debates whether to attend Tiro's dinner party and the White Lion Project hits a few road bumps because of Karel's cold feet.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Tension mounts for the Lebone family as the night of Tiro's party arrives and Tiro has to deal with seeing Lelo on Modise's arm as his fiance.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Marang brings someone new into the Lebone house while Bernie and Itumeleng continue their hot affair in secret.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Tristan tells Karel he has to be excluded from the white lion project, and gets an unexpected response.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: When Nick leaves the lodge in the lurch, Bernie has an opportunity to step in and shine. She also takes the opportunity to test her boundaries with Itumeleng, but will she push him too far?

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Marang shares the secret of her divorce with Hope. Kate realises that balancing her newly revived career with her marriage to Tristan is going to be far from easy, and Bernie fights to claim the top spot in the lodge's kitchen.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Karel and Tristan form an uneasy alliance, but Kate is feeling increasingly offended by Tristan's lack of understanding.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Marang gets served divorce papers and shares with Hope why she is the "defendant".

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: The tension between Tristan and Kate increases, and Amber starts to feel the effects of the worsening domestic situation.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Kate is stuck in the middle of nowhere, and her attempts to connect with Tristan fail. Tristan finally learns something has happened, and the race is on to rescue Kate.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Tristan and Jack both race to save Kate, but only one will get there on time.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Itumeleng forces Modise to make a decision about Lelo, then fights his urge to be a part of whatever Ayanda is putting together.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Itumeleng forces Modise to make a decision about Lelo, then fights his urge to be a part of whatever Ayanda is putting together.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: As the staff gossip about the big break up, Modise appears to be falling apart, but his binge causes him to finally stand up to Itumeleng.

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: When Tiro learns of Modise and Lelo's break-up, he acts immediately, despite the problems this causes with his family.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Bernie and Itumeleng reach a stalemate in their relationship due to the cunning and enigmatic presence of Ayanda.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Itumeleng is still resisting Ayanda's attempts to seduce him - both professionally and personally. She turns up the heat by forcing a confrontation Itumeleng is sure to hate.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Ayanda oversteps the mark and Itumeleng realises it is time for her to go. Zoe and Modise try to make sense of their gigantic mistake and Lelo has shocking news for Modise.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Lelo and Tiro decide to take things to the next level, while Modise comes to terms with the breakup. Kate has a crisis of faith.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: The Dinaledi staff are becoming tired and overworked and Khumo's attempts to keep everything running smoothly puts him in conflict with Mama Rose.

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Tiro's unwavering in his love for Lelo, even against Marang's vehement opposition. Kate butts heads with Tristan when he finds out that she is not proud of her family and who she has become.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: During an outing with a few of her friends, Kate realises that Karel understands her situation. But will she make peace with her place?

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Dinaledi lodge is still not running at full tilt, and with a demanding VIP guest on the books Khumo and Itumeleng have their hands full.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Jack and Isaac experience the beginnings of an unlikely, but mutual understanding and respect as they prepare for a hunt.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Jack finally spots leopard tracks, but he has to deal with Isaac's suspicions about the legitimacy of the leopard hunt.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview: DeSantos gets his prize but Isaac learns that hunting at Dinaledi is far more complicated than it seems. Tuelo finally confronts Marang about her divorce.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Marang gets advice from Itumeleng that helps her restore her relationship with Tuelo. But then he destroys it all again. Khumo and Diksie's marriage hits an even bigger snag.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: No matter how much Itumeleng resists, Ayanda is determined to bring him to his knees. Khumo flounders without Diksie, and she shows no sign of forgiving him

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Kate's friend Nina comes to visit the Van Reenen's and Kate realises that she's happy with her life. Lelo and Zoe's friendship continues to unravel, due to Zoe's one night stand with Modise.

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: After the failed pitch to Rratladi, Ayanda feels Itumeleng has betrayed her chances of grabbing the tender for the bridge, so she gets revenge via Modise.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: The Tladi Brothers almost go to war over an increasingly manipulative Ayanda.

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Modise plays along with Ayanda's games to collect info for Itumeleng. Marang makes Lelo's life hell which Tiro counters by offering Marang a job.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: humo and Diksie restore the German couple's faith in love and marriage, learning a lesson about their own relationship along the way.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Lelo still feels like an outsider in the Lebone family and this isolation is only made worse when Marang's divorce comes through and everyone rallies around her.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Kate struggles to reconcile her dreams with the pressure of her big news. Khumo is so wrapped up in lodge business that he cannot see that Diksie has other things on her mind that she needs to discuss with him.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Kate tries to come to terms with everything, and Tristan tells Blessing his big news. Lelo and Zoe are pitted against one another in a battle for a promotion.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Khumo and the lodge staff continue to hunt for the mysterious and elusive lodge reviewer. And Kate grows more and more ambivalent much to the delight of Jack.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: After much sleuthing Diksie, believes she knows the reviewer's identity - but the truth is not what she expected at all.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Tristan tries to get the truth out of Kate about how she really feels, however when she finally tells him, it's not what he wants to hear.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: A visit from Kate's friend Nina serves to highlight Kate's mixed feelings about her pregnancy, causing a wide rift between Kate and Tristan.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: In ‘winning’ the promotion at Chic, Lelo considers quitting and is seduced by Tiro's offer to buy her her own magazine.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Lelo's new promotion doesn't go as well as she thought. Unable to resolve his conflict with Isaac, Jack takes him out in the bush for a little unofficial discipline.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Lelo is forced to play her hand by a defiant Zoe, and finds herself in a difficult situation with Rosie, who no longer trusts her.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: Tiro heads into the bush with Blessing and Tristan, in an attempt to win a bet. Karel voices his concerns about his family to Marang, during a visit to the Kwena bridge.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Marang, Blessing, and Tristan push a determined Tiro to the limits in the bush. A conflicted Itumeleng has to do a balancing act between the lucrative bridge tender and appeasing his father.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: Tristan takes a big step forward with his white lion project, just as he and Kate get bad news, news which leaves Kate with an enormous choice.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: RraTladi has a dream that foreshadows the fall of the Tladi family. Kate falls into a deep depression. Lelo has Chic and Rosie under control until Zoe returns.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Tiro and Tristan try to work out why they've been sent a picture of Itumeleng on a leopard hunt and what it might mean for their poaching investigation.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Itumeleng manipulates Marang into betraying Tiro. Tiro reveals his plan to flush Itumeleng out of his hole and expose the illegal hunting.

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: RraTladi's dreams are confirmed: the Tladi family is in danger. Itumeleng is exposed and his world begins to fall apart.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Lelo and Zoe are committed to bringing down their common foe, Rosie. And problems begin to mount for Itumeleng as he faces formidable and unexpected challenges from Tiro, and RraTladi.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: When Modise is sent to the lodge to do damage control, Mama Rose fully understands the implications of RraTladi's dream of the "Danger from Within".

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Modise realises he has been brought here to keep an eye on Itumeleng. RraTladi lets Mama Rose in on his thoughts about the future of the chieftaincy, and they are dark.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Kate and Tristan drift farther apart leading her to do the unthinkable with Jack. Marang confesses her betrayal to Tiro.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Itumeleng refuses to right his wrongs and go to his ailing father's bedside. Kate and Jack fall for each other even further, while Tristan begins to suspect something is up.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Kate tries to deal with her guilty conscience. Her guilt impacts on her relationship with Tristan, and she breaks it off with Jack. Tiro calls off his campaign against Itumeleng, at the request of Marang.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Itumeleng receives exactly what he wanted, at precisely the wrong time. Kate and Jack reinstate their affair on the day that Tristan's dream comes to fruition.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Modise agrees to help Itumeleng but lays down some ground rules that shift the balance of power in their relationship.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Rratladi ponders his own mortality and the future of his family and community. And Lelo and Tiro put their relationship on hold.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: RraTladi continues to recover, but confides that the future of the community is still uncertain. Although experiencing private doubts about his successor, he firmly endorses Itumeleng as future chief.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Tiro gives Lelo the space she needs to make a crucial career decision. He refuses to get involved in the decision and they agree she has to make it on her own. But help arrives from an unexpected source.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Lelo resigns from Chic. Bernie and Lindsay threaten to expose Jack and Kate. After hitting brick walls with Jack and Isaac, Modise presents Itumeleng with evidence of illegal hunting at Dinaledi.

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Modise reveals that he is a better man than Itumeleng when he organises a clan feast in honour of RraTladi. Marang's antagonism grows when Tiro refuses to attend RraTladi's feast.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Itumeleng continues to distance himself from his father, while Modise becomes closer to the old man.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Khumo decides it's high time he was promoted to General Manager of the lodge. Karel talks Kate out of coming clean to Tristan, and instead she blurts out that she's going to have a boy.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Itumeleng is distracted from the party preparations by Khumo's bid for promotion, and Jack's threats to expose him.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Having watched while his father died, Itumeleng tries to assert his control over the community, then Modise starts asking questions about what really happened in the moments before his father's death.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Modise can't shake the feeling that his father's death was far from natural. Khumo and Diksie find it hard to conceal their possible pregnancy.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: Diksie comes to terms with how much she wants a baby. RraTladi's body is returned home and Bernie turns Itumeleng down when he tries to seduce her.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: RraTladi is buried. A grief stricken Mama Rose shares a personal secret to Modise and after hearing some disturbing news, Modise, now beliefs that his father's death wasn't an accident.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Tiro and Lelo find a relative to represent the Lebone family and move forward with their wedding plans. And Karel struggles to find a minder for Amber.

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: Modise gets on the wrong side of Mogorosi, not knowing that Mogorosi might side with Itumeleng. Jack finally discovers the identity of his shooter.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: Jacks paranoia increases as Blessing reveals the identity of the man in the camera trap image. Itumeleng promises Isaac a position of power when he becomes chief, which brings Isaac into further conflict with Rose.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Itumeleng learns more about the betrayal that is crippling his attempts to become chief. Mama Rose and Modise realise Itumeleng is ahead of them in the race.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: Lindsay and Amber continue to bond famously, while Karel slyly encourages Jack to look for his future elsewhere.

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: In the wake of Mama Rose being fired and Lindsay going missing, Dinaledi struggles to meet the demands of a temperamental Bollywood actress.

videos.title: Episode 95
videos.overview: Karel saves Jack's life and they have to work together to get rid of the evidence. Diksie tames "the princess" but her success is short lived.

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview: Karel and Jack lie to Lindsay about the events of the previous evening. Jack is overcome with guilt, and Karel offers him comfort. Diksie confronts Jiah, the difficult guest - with a surprising outcome.

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview: Itumeleng lures Modise into the bush for a showdown, but only one of them has a gun. Karel calls the cops in and Rossouw identifies the owner of the burnt out bakkie, then he decides to call Jack in for questioning.

videos.title: Episode 98
videos.overview: Mama Rose attempts to get her job back. Kate reacts to the news of who has actually been taking care of Amber, and Jack becomes a murder suspect.

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview: Itumeleng and Modise agree to put aside their differences for the good of the Tladi clan but come up against fierce opposition from Mama Rose. Karel tries to get jack out of hot water.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: Itumeleng and Modise's uneasy truce allows Mama Rose to return to work. Diksie's taste of the high life comes to an end when Jiah leaves the lodge.

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: Itumeleng decides to rekindle his affair with Bernie. Mama Rose locks horns with Marang and Isaac over their loyalties concerning Itumeleng. Isaac has officially taken over as head ranger, and strangely, Jack seems to be happy with that. Lelo officially moves in with all her boxes of clothes, much to Marang's dissatisfaction.

videos.title: Episode 102
videos.overview: Jack wants to lie low but Kate and Tristan are determined to send him packing. Bernie is considering re-starting her relationship with Itumeleng when Marang sideswipes her thinking.

videos.title: Episode 103
videos.overview: Bernie and Itumeleng continue to deny their feelings for each other. Lindsay suffers from post-traumatic stress, and finds an unlikely friend.

videos.title: Episode 104
videos.overview: Itumeleng sets a trap for Jack and he walks straight into it. Isaac has the chance to clear Jack's name but sells him out to Rossouw instead. Itumeleng rewards Isaac with the Head Ranger position.

videos.title: Episode 105
videos.overview: Was Jack framed, his innocence still hangs in the balance. Itumeleng asks Marang to oversee a Black Tie event at Dinaledi - she is flattered and accepts the challenge.

videos.title: Episode 106
videos.overview: Jack confronts Itumeleng. Marang realises that she may have bitten off more than she can chew organising the Black Tie Event, however she finds an unlikely ally.

videos.title: Episode 107
videos.overview: Incriminating evidence is found in Jack's room. Jack is suspended and ordered to get off the reserve pending a disciplinary hearing. Marang's event starts to come together.

videos.title: Episode 108
videos.overview: Dinaledi plays host to the rich and fabulous, as the day of Marang's party finally arrives. But Marang's elation at her success is tempered by the arrival of an unexpected guest - Idols star Sindi Nene.

videos.title: Episode 109
videos.overview: Itumeleng is desperate for funds. Jack tells all to Tristan. Marang is torn between a job offer and Zweli wanting herback.

videos.title: Episode 110
videos.overview: Itumeleng manipulates a staff memeber further into being his pawn. Marang feels pressured about making a decision about her future.

videos.title: Episode 111
videos.overview: The completion of the Kwena Bridge is under threat. Itumeleng hatches a devious plot. Marang choices are getting more and more dufficulti.

videos.title: Episode 112
videos.overview: Tiro is furious at Marang. Itumeleng makes an announcement that shocks everybody.

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: Lindsay continues to pursue Tristan, while Jack fails to prove his innocence. Itumeleng gets an unexpected surprise.

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: Itumeleng confronts Jack. Marang makes a lifechanging decision, but is it the right one?

videos.title: Episode 115
videos.overview: Kate and Tristan suspect someone close to them of a burglary and want that person gone. Jack has won the favor of Karel who will do anything to bring his enemy down.

videos.title: Episode 116
videos.overview: Jack's attempts to get a confession leads to catastrophic consequences. Marang wises up to a friend's past and makes a drastic decision about her future.

videos.title: Episode 117
videos.overview: With Kate's life on a thred, Tristan is forced to make a difficult choice. Jack blames himself for Kate's misfortune, and his guilt is compounded when he has to tell Amber.

videos.title: Episode 118
videos.overview: Tristan reels in shock as Kate fights for her life. Karel is furious when he finds out the part that Jack played in Kate's misfortune.

videos.title: Episode 119
videos.overview: Will Kate regains her consciousness? The arrival of VIP guests threatens to unsettle the newly appointed Ashwin, much to Lindsay's secret delight. Isaac wants to know the truth about Kate's misfortune but Itumeleng shuts him down.

videos.title: Episode 120
videos.overview: Tristan has a change of heart regarding Jack and his life is changed forever. Marang struggles to define her relationship with her family, but she has found a new decisiveness. Isaac finds his authority being undermined by Ashwin's lies.

videos.title: Episode 121
videos.overview: Lelo secretly enlists the help of a rather reluctant cook. Isaac goes on a shopping spree and Ashwin uses this as further ammunition.

videos.title: Episode 122
videos.overview: Lelo starts to sneak around on a friend for a good cause. Isaac and an enemy's feud escalates. The Van Reenen family start to fall apart, while a friend is forced to relive a tragic moment.

videos.title: Episode 123
videos.overview: Kate blames herself while Tristan struggles to reach out to her. Tristan's unstable emotions give Tiro an advantage in an important project.

videos.title: Episode 124
videos.overview: Despite attempts to reach out to each other, Kate and Tristan's relationship is rocky. Karel takes matters into his own hands.

videos.title: Episode 125
videos.overview: An old and good friend of Kate's comes to her rescue - much to Tristan's dismay. An Elder visits the lodge and fuels Itumeleng's fire to be crowned.

videos.title: Episode 126
videos.overview: Tristan doesn't come home and misses an important interview with the press. He struggles to reach out to Kate. Nina doubts whether her efforts are making a difference.

videos.title: Episode 127
videos.overview: Tristan's denial spirals out of control with possible disastrous consequences. Mogorosi is forced to lie when he's pressed for information about Isaac's father.

videos.title: Episode 128
videos.overview: Itumeleng and the community celebrate the bridge opening. Itumeleng revels in his success and draws two family members closer to him.

videos.title: Episode 129
videos.overview: Isaac continues relentlessly to dig up his family's past, as a close family friend struggles to keep it buried. And Bernie fights her mixed up feelings for a philandering friend.

videos.title: Episode 130
videos.overview: In her ever failing attempts to conceal the truth, Mama Rose discovers a curious turn of events concerning RraTladi's will.

videos.title: Episode 131
videos.overview: Kate is forced to evaluate her life choices. The Tladis prepare for the reading of their father's will.

videos.title: Episode 132
videos.overview: After discovering a secret that could change Itumeleng's life, a worrisome Itumeleng is caught between a rock and a hard place .

videos.title: Episode 133
videos.overview: Zoe arrives at the lodge with a mysterious man. Tristan and Kate start rebuilding their marriage - Jack feels excluded and Karel suggests he take charge of his life.

videos.title: Episode 134
videos.overview: Itumeleng has plans with his father's will, while RraTladi's lawyer is caught up in the Tladi feud. Tiro hits it off with Zoe's rich fiancé , while Lelo views the man and relationships with scepticism.

videos.title: Episode 135
videos.overview: Mama Rose and Mogorosi try to wrest the upper hand. Tiro grows increasingly frustrated with an employee's absence and he is forced to turn to a rival for help .

videos.title: Episode 136
videos.overview: Itumeleng is outraged when he learns what is in Rratladi's will. Modise continues to distance himself from Mama Rose.

videos.title: Episode 137
videos.overview: Isaac confronts Itumeleng about a personal issue while Diksie returns to Dinaledi. Karel asks Tiro for a favour and Jason shares good news with Zoe.

videos.title: Episode 138
videos.overview: Mama Rose continues to struggle to keep the lid on her secret, as she and Itumeleng bump heads. Jack gets a new lease on life while Isaac wrestles with his role in the Tladi fold.

videos.title: Episode 139
videos.overview: Mama Rose and Modise are suspicious of Itumeleng's sudden desire to embrace Isaac as part of the family. Mama Rose walks straight into Itumeleng's trap.

videos.title: Episode 140
videos.overview: Isaac struggles to come to terms with the truth about his father, and decides to leave - but not before revealing his mother's secret to all at Dinaledi.

videos.title: Episode 141
videos.overview: The lodge staff gossip about Mama Rose's secret. Modise and Marang blame Itumeleng for a friend's trauma. Jason is only interested in Zoe for one thing, and it's not her creative vision.

videos.title: Episode 142
videos.overview: Isaac is in hiding when Modise and Itumeleng find out that he wants to sell his inheritance. Sarah provokes a relative to live up to his new lofty ideals - but in order to do this, the relative must return to Dinaledi.

videos.title: Episode 143
videos.overview: Modise and Itumeleng are on the lookout for Isaac to confront him about his inheritance. Jason turns Zoe into a jealous wreck after flirting with a visitor.

videos.title: Episode 144
videos.overview: Tiro has asks Jack to propose rangers to assist Tristan - but the ranger that he puts forward will antagonise them. Marang's daughter Zintle sets her sights on a lodge employee - and pursues a romantic encounter, despite her mother's objections.

videos.title: Episode 145
videos.overview: Mogorosi attacks an old rival in a bid to hold onto power, but the three Tladi brothers go on the offensive to stop him.

videos.title: Episode 146
videos.overview: Under pressure from Itumeleng, an elder announces the date for the confirmation of the new chief, but he continues to sow seeds of doubt about who the new chief will be.

videos.title: Episode 147
videos.overview: Zintle's sexuality causes conflit at the lodge. The Tladi community prepares to mark the end of their mourning period for RraTladi, with a traditional cereMondayy.

videos.title: Episode 148
videos.overview: Sarah's suspicions that Kate and Jack had an affair are confirmed. Kate fears that Sarah is going to tell her Tristan everything.

videos.title: Episode 149
videos.overview: Zoe tells Tiro and Lelo that a close friend has made a run for it. Isaac feels pressure concerning the inheritance that RraTladi left for him, and what he should do with it.

videos.title: Episode 150
videos.overview: Jason and Tiro try to convince Lelo and Zoe to work together. Itumeleng seeks to win the hearts and minds of the community with Mama Rose's help.

videos.title: Episode 151
videos.overview: Kate tries to dissuade Sarah from revealing her affair with Jack, but Sarah remains unmoved. Finally, as the pressure intensifies, Kate takes matters into her own hands.

videos.title: Episode 152
videos.overview:
The Van Reenens family is plunged into crises that can destroy them.

The heat is turned up on Jason. Itumeleng proves that he has a heart at the community Christmas party.

videos.title: Episode 153
videos.overview: Jack flees for his life while the Van Reenen family teeters on the brink of destruction. Marang's Christmas party is nearly derailed when old family resentments come to the fore. Is Jason's masterplan going to work?.

videos.title: Episode 154
videos.overview: The hunter becomes the hunted. Zoe's world shatters when she finds out the truth. Marang and Zintle continue to pit themselves against each other in the age old mother-daughter battle.

videos.title: Episode 155
videos.overview: Mama Rose goes on a mission to find Isaac a wife. Ashwin and Zintle continue their flirtatious dance, and things get even more heated.

videos.title: Episode 156
